statements.statement: The hydro-boost unit converts hydraulic power from the steering pump to mechanical power to the master cylinder.
The hydro-boost unit provides power assist during braking.

statements.answer_quote:
components identified as possible influences on hydro-boost operation in the brake guidance are:  
1. Power steering pump
statements.statement: The brake guidance identifies the power steering pump as a steering-system component that may influence hydro-boost operation.
